_status: PROPOSAL (Kimi B, 2026-11-17). Revisioned, allowlisted character-editor protocol. In-play UI (NOT the dev scenario panel). Awaits Claude freeze with the other M2.5 contracts.
principles: Typed allowlist only: no raw __dict__ / arbitrary JSON paths / set_flag.
Apply is immediate, atomic, revisioned (save revision bump) and journaled/audited with ACTUAL before/after values.
Editor omniscience is out-of-character: inspection never propagates knowledge to NPCs (C's observer records untouched).
Rename changes the display name only; person_id is identity and never changes.
Money edits are OMITTED (no ledger-adjustment command frozen yet).
The fixed 18+ rule, chronology, consent, parentage, RNG and pending samples are protected: editing them returns typed errors, never applies.

Individual changes never alias a shared profile: editing a person clones the affected values into that person's own record; save-local profile/jurisdiction edits create save-local overrides, not catalog mutations.

scopes.person: edit one person's allowed attributes (attraction_profile fields + culture_id)
scopes.personal_tenets: edit one person's personal_tenet_overrides (dissent from their faith's public tenets)
scopes.faith_profile: SAVE-LOCAL override of a faith's public tenet stances; applies to believers without a personal override; never mutates the catalog
scopes.jurisdiction: SAVE-LOCAL override of a jurisdiction's recognition/consequence rules; reprojects current recognition only

commands.name: edit_person_attributes
commands.effects: immediately reprojects future offer scores for this person; does NOT touch existing relationships/unities/consent

commands.name: edit_personal_tenets
commands.effects: this person only; never other believers; cannot create consent or force acceptance

commands.name: edit_faith_profile
commands.effects: creates/updates a save-local override (resolution_order in policy-catalogs.json); believers WITH personal overrides are unaffected; bumps policy_revision

commands.name: edit_jurisdiction

consequences.item: same shape as jurisdiction_presets[].consequences (typed; max_per_occurrence_key required)

commands.effects: reprojects CURRENT recognition of affected unions (law_version bumps on the override; old unions keep their historical law_version); NEVER deletes relationships, rewrites past consent/discovery/birth outcomes, or retro-repeats penalties; bumps policy_revision

commands.name: rename_person
commands.effects: display name only; person_id, chronology, kinship and history unchanged (spec freeze fixture)

protected_fields._rule: any patch touching these fails with a typed error BEFORE anything applies

request_shape.expected_revision: int (same optimistic concurrency as frozen M2 commands)
request_shape.request_id: string (same replay-ledger rules as frozen M2 commands)

EditorCommand.name: one of commands[].name
EditorCommand.patch: map of field->value, allowlisted per command

preview_shape._route: POST /api/games/<id>/editor/preview (proposed; A registers the shared endpoint)

response.policy_revision_delta: int (how many policy_revision bumps apply would cause)
response.journal_preview: human-readable before/after lines for the audit

response.policy_revision: int (new policy revision; unchanged if no policy data changed)

apply_shape._storage: audit entries are appended to the save envelope field `editor_audit` (REQUEST to A: reserve this field) and the in-world journal only where the change is diegetic (rename); scoring-relevant attribute edits are out-of-character and journal-quiet

pending_supersession._rule: an apply that changes policy data while a related offer is pending atomically supersedes that offer and resumes its stored safe continuation, KEEPING consumed attempts/cooldowns and already-applied pre-effects; unrelated pending choices keep their stored samples untouched (spec 02-contracts §6). B does not implement the offer machinery — this is the exact hook B requests from A/C:

request_to_a_c.semantics: A cancels/supersedes matching pending offers and resumes their safe continuation; attempts/cooldowns/pre-effects preserved; never a resample of a rejected offer

v3_effect_targets._for_c: typed domain effects the v3 schema may call on B's domain (read-only or command-shaped; no raw setters)

convert_profile.validates: typed; bumps policy-relevant caches; goes through the same supersession hook
